如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    “先生，您要找谁？”
刚走了几步，林逸就被大厦的保安给拦住了。
“等下啊，我看看。”
林逸心道，还是大城市正规啊，还有保安，不过这保安也只是个花架子，还不如二狗蛋厉害呢。
二狗蛋是林逸的一个玩伴，虽然不会功夫，但是一拳却可以打死一头牛。
在林逸看来，这保安比牛差远了，还没有牛强壮呢。
林逸从裤兜里又摸出一个纸条来，看了看上面的字，然后道：“我找楚鹏展。”
“楚鹏展？是谁？这名字怎么这么熟悉呢？”
保安一愣，在嘴里默念了一遍。
“董事长啊！”
站在一旁的另一个岁数比较大的保安反应比较快，一下子就想到了楚鹏展是何许人也，顿时一惊。
连忙拉了拉之前那个保安的衣角，小声道：“别乱说话，被队长听到了小心被炒鱿鱼！”
“啊！”
之前那个保安听了那个老保安的话，顿时吓了一大跳，瞪大了眼睛，后悔自己刚才多嘴。
没什么事儿瞎唠叨个什么劲儿啊？
现在好了，连董事长都不认识，还做什么保安啊？保护谁去呀？
不过，这保安看了看林逸的穿着打扮，眼睛滴溜溜的一转，就又不觉得害怕了。
怎么看林逸怎么都不像是和董事长能扯上关系的人，一个是世界五百强的超大型集团董事长，一个是乡下进城的民工，好像没有任何的关联吧？
这小子不会是哪个工地的，来找董事长告状的吧？
想到这里，保安一下子就提高了警惕，前两天可是刚看过一部类似的电影，里面就有个民工去找总裁要钱的。

想到这里，这个保安和老保安对视了一眼，显然，两人都想到一块去了。
“你找楚董事长干什么？”
老保安清了清嗓子，一脸严肃的盯着林逸，生怕他做出什么过激的举动出来。
“不是我找他，是我家老头子叫我找他。”
林逸懒洋洋的说道。
雇主在现实中是什么身份，林逸一点儿也不在乎，反正都是求他办事儿。
“恩？你家老头子？”
听了林逸的话，两个保安更加不疑有它了，电影里那个民工是替他哥要钱，眼前这小子肯定是替他老子要钱了。
“得了，别说那些个没用的，就说楚鹏展在几楼吧，我去找他！”
林逸可没时间和这两个小保安废话，还是赶紧见到正主再说吧。
“董事长没在，你走吧……”
老保安再次打量了林逸两眼，确定他绝对应该和董事长没有任何关系之后，直接的下了逐客令。
林逸懒得和这两个人墨迹了，两人的眼神林逸自然看在眼里，他们在想什么林逸也能猜到个十之八、九，不就是看自己穿得土气么？
狗眼看人低！
“既然没在，那我就进去等他！”
林逸说完，就大步的向公司里面走去。
“等等，你不能进去！”
两个保安没想到林逸居然敢硬闯，连忙想要阻止。
而正在这个时候，一楼的电梯门电梯。
“算时间应该差不多了，小逸这孩子怎么还不和我联系呢？李福，要不你直接开车去车站接一下吧，照片你不是已经看过了么。”

有些富态的中年男人对另一个黑瘦的中年男人吩咐道。
“好的，楚总，我这就过去。”
李福连忙恭敬的说道。
李福还没等走呢，楚鹏展就听到了公司门口处的争吵声，顿时皱了皱眉，“你先去看看怎么回事儿？”
“怎么回事儿？”
李福快步的向公司门口的方向走去，就看到公司的两个保安正在阻拦一个年轻小伙子进入公司。
“福伯，这个人说要找董事长，还强行的往公司里面闯……”
保安自然认得李福，李福在公司里虽然没有具体的行政职务，但是却是董事长最亲近的人！
如果硬说他在公司里是什么职位，那就只能说他是楚董事长的司机了。
不过公司里的人都知道，李福不仅仅是司机那么简单。
所以这些保安也根本没拿李福当司机，而是当成领导一样尊敬。
很多情况下，李福的话就代表了董事长的意思。
“你……”
李福看着林逸，瞪大了眼睛，有些吃惊的道：“你就是林逸？”
“是我。”
林逸看了李福一眼，点了点头。
从李福出现，他林逸在注意这个人了，凭直觉，这个人应该不是楚鹏展。
身为一个集团的董事长，身上自然而然的都有一种上位者威严的气势，但是这个人却没有，虽然严肃，也被人尊敬，不过一个人的气势是无法改变的。

After taking a few steps, Lin Yi was stopped by the security guard of the building.
"Wait a minute, let me take a look."
Lin Yi thought to himself, it is still formal in a big city, and there are security guards, but this security guard is just a showman, not as powerful as Ergoudan.
Ergoudan is one of Lin Yi's playmates. Although he doesn't know kung fu, he can kill a cow with one punch.
In Lin Yi's opinion, this security guard is far worse than an ox, and is not as strong as an ox.
Lin Yi took out another note from his trouser pocket, read the words on it, and then said: "I'm looking for Chu Pengzhan."
"Chu Pengzhan? Who is it? Why is this name so familiar?"
The security guard was stunned and recited silently in his mouth.
"Chairman!"
Another older security guard standing nearby reacted quickly. He suddenly thought of who Chu Pengzhan was and was shocked.
He quickly tugged on the clothes of the previous security guard and whispered, "Don't talk nonsense. If the captain hears it, you may be fired!"
"Ah!"
The previous security guard was shocked when he heard what the old security guard said, his eyes widened, and he regretted that he had said too much just now.
Why are you blabbing on when you have nothing to do?
Well now, if you don’t even know the chairman, how can you be a security guard? Who are you going to protect?
However, the security guard looked at Lin Yi's clothes and rolled his eyes, and he no longer felt scared.
No matter how you look at it, Lin Yi doesn't look like someone who can be related to the chairman. One is the chairman of a large Fortune 500 group, and the other is a migrant worker from the countryside who came to the city. There doesn't seem to be any connection, right?
This guy couldn't be from some construction site and came to complain to the chairman, right?
Thinking of this, the security guard suddenly became more vigilant. He had just watched a similar movie two days ago, in which a migrant worker went to the president to ask for money.
Thinking of this, the security guard and the old security guard looked at each other. Obviously, they both thought of going together.
"What are you doing with Chairman Chu?"
The old security guard cleared his throat and stared at Lin Yi seriously, fearing that he would do something drastic.
"I wasn't looking for him, it was my old man who asked me to look for him."
Lin Yi said lazily.
Lin Yi didn't care at all who his employer was in reality. He was always asking him to do things anyway.
"Huh? Your old man?"
After listening to Lin Yi's words, the two security guards were even more convinced that he had it. The migrant worker in the movie was asking for money for his brother, and the guy in front of him must be asking for money for his father.
"Come on, don't talk about those useless things. Just tell me which floor Chu Pengzhan is on. I'll go find him!"
Lin Yi didn't have time to talk nonsense with these two little security guards, so he had better meet the real owner as soon as possible.
"The chairman is not here, please go..."
The old security guard looked at Lin Yi again, and after confirming that he definitely had nothing to do with the chairman, he directly issued an eviction order.
Lin Yi was too lazy to talk to these two people. Lin Yi could naturally see the look in their eyes. Lin Yi could probably guess what they were thinking. Wasn't it because he was dressed in a tacky way?
Dogs look down upon people!
"Since he's not here, I'll go in and wait for him!"
After Lin Yi finished speaking, he strode into the company.
"Wait, you can't go in!"
The two security guards didn't expect Lin Yi to dare to break in, and quickly tried to stop him.
At this time, the elevator door on the first floor opened.
"It's almost time. Why hasn't Xiaoyi contacted me yet? Li Fu, why don't you just drive to the station to pick him up? Haven't you already seen the photo?"
Some rich middle-aged man ordered another dark and thin middle-aged man.
"Okay, Mr. Chu, I'll be there right away."
Li Fu said quickly and respectfully.
Before Li Fu could leave, Chu Pengzhan heard that the companyHearing the quarrel at the door, he immediately frowned, "Why don't you go and see what's going on first?"
"What's going on?"
Li Fu walked quickly towards the entrance of the company and saw two security guards of the company blocking a young man from entering the company.
"Uncle Fu, this man said he wanted to find the chairman, and he forced his way into the company..."
The security guard naturally recognized Li Fu. Although Li Fu did not have a specific administrative position in the company, he was the person closest to the chairman!
If we insist on what position he holds in the company, we can only say that he is Chairman Chu's driver.
But everyone in the company knows that Li Fu is more than just a driver.
Therefore, these security guards did not treat Li Fu as a driver at all, but respected him as a leader.
In many cases, Li Fu's words represent the chairman's meaning.
"You..."
Li Fu looked at Lin Yi, his eyes widened, and said in surprise: "Are you Lin Yi?"
"It's me."
Lin Yi glanced at Li Fu and nodded.
From the moment Li Fu appeared, Lin Yi was paying attention to this person. Based on his intuition, this person should not be Chu Pengzhan.
As the chairman of a group, he naturally has the majestic aura of a superior person, but this person does not have it. Although he is serious and respected by others, a person's aura cannot be changed.
